content: प्रवर्तित {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} .²1 Caused to turn, made to go or roll onwards, revolving; चमरान् परितः प्रवर्तिताश्वः <ls>R. 9. 66</ls>. .²2 Founded, set up, established. .²3 Prompted, incited, instigated. .²4 Kindled; प्रवर्तितो दीप इव प्रदीपात् <ls>R. 5. 37</ls>. .²5 Caused, made. .²6 Purified, rendered pure; गोभिः प्रवर्तिते तीर्थे <ls>Ms. 11. 196</ls>. .²7 Informed.
